title: Construction Management Services for NYC Parks, Citywide
agency_path: City of New York > Parks and Recreation
description_text:
NYCs Department of Parks and Recreation is seeking qualified firms to perform comprehensive construction management services, partial construction management services, or consulting services for various City-owned properties located within the five boroughs, on an as needed basis. Request for Proposal (RFP) documents are available online for free through the NYC PASSPort System https://www.nyc.gov/site/mocs/passport/about-passport.page You must have a NYC ID Account and Login. Submissions must be submitted through PASSPort. Please visit the following link to view the documents for this solicitation and for further details. https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/bpm/process_manage_extranet/38665 Any inquiries concerning this solicitation should be directed by email to rfpsubmissions@parks.nyc.gov, with the subject line EPIN: 84627P0003 Construction Management RFP.
